title: Complete lesson lists and connected course progress
summary: Show all published lessons directly on every course overview, retain curriculum context through lesson navigation, and automatically complete lessons after required assessments.

changes.detail: Added a shared searchable lesson list grouped by module with explicit not-started, in-progress and completed states.
Course and curriculum overviews show all lessons before supplementary outcomes, syllabus and workshops; resume prefers the last unfinished lesson in that course.
Preserved the selected curriculum path through lesson opening, previous/next and return-to-course links, using a namespaced course identifier.
Quiz-based lessons complete automatically at the assessment stage when all quiz answers and required practice confirmations pass. Lessons without quizzes retain explicit completion.
Added completion feedback with next-lesson navigation and a direct all-course-lessons button; reduced lesson hero size.
Removed the additional module-opening step from course overviews while retaining workshops and planned-topic descriptions.

validation.name: Automated validation
validation.detail: Typecheck, lint, navigation/completion and history checks pending.

validation.name: Content and device scope
validation.detail: Existing published lessons are exposed; missing lessons are not fabricated. Visual and native-device review not yet performed; no deployment.
